tools.name: open_nimistu_page
tools.description: Open a nimistu page in the browser by its path or full nimistu.ee URL (e.g. a company or person result from search_estonian_companies). Same-origin only; navigates the current tab.

url.description: A nimistu path like /12345678-acme-ou or a full https://nimistu.ee/... URL.

tools.name: search_estonian_companies
tools.description: Search the Estonian public register (nimistu) for companies, people and trademarks by name or 8-digit registry code. Returns matches with their name, registry code and nimistu.ee path (pass a result's path to open_nimistu_page to open it).

query.description: Company name, person name or 8-digit registry code.
